sentences.text: Matthew Kerr attended the meeting as the client.
The purpose of the meeting was to discuss a potential claim related to alleged sexual abuse by Brian Hollis, a former swimming coach at Harbridge Swimming Club.
Brian Hollis was the individual involved in the alleged incident.
Brian Hollis ran the junior squad at Harbridge Swimming Club.
Matthew Kerr joined the swimming club when he was nine years old.
Brian Hollis became Matthew Kerr's coach when he moved up to the squad at age eleven.
Matthew Kerr alleges that Brian Hollis touched him in the changing room after training, when others had gone.
Matthew Kerr alleges that Brian Hollis made him touch him.
Brian Hollis told Matthew Kerr that the touching was part of being in the squad and that everyone did it.
The alleged incidents occurred every Saturday morning after squad training.
The incidents occurred over a period of about two years, from when Matthew was eleven until he was nearly thirteen.
The incidents occurred roughly from 1996 to 1998.
The incidents stopped when Matthew Kerr quit swimming.
Matthew Kerr told his mother when he was 13 about the incidents.
Matthew Kerr's mother took him out of the club after learning about the incidents.
Matthew Kerr does not know if his mother reported the incidents to anyone.
Matthew Kerr told his wife Claire about the incidents in 2020.
Matthew Kerr told his GP about the incidents.
Matthew Kerr reported the incidents to the police in March of the previous year (implied to be 2023).
Matthew Kerr gave a statement to the police in March.
The police have interviewed Brian Hollis.
The police investigation is still ongoing.
Matthew Kerr has the details of the police officer involved: DC Farrow.
Matthew Kerr has heard that Brian Hollis also touched other boys in the squad.
Matthew Kerr has not seen anything happen to anyone else himself.
Matthew Kerr has not seen any evidence of the incidents beyond what people have said.
Matthew Kerr has had anxiety for years and has experienced panic attacks.
Matthew Kerr had counselling through work in 2021.
Matthew Kerr had three months off sick in 2021.
Matthew Kerr has the sick notes from 2021.
